1.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_CALL_FAILED_NO_CHARGE
1.description: The retainer managing this mannequin has been released from service. To access this mannequin, place it again and assign a new retainer.

2.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_CHANGE_STATUS_DISABLE
2.description: You must remove all gear from the mannequin before changing its settings.

3.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_SELL_DISABLE
3.description: You must remove all gear from the mannequin before you can list items for sale.

4.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_DISPLAY_DISABLE
4.description: You must remove all gear from the mannequin before you can list items to display.

22.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_Q4_000_001
22.description: Your mannequin's class will be changed to <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103>. Proceed?

30.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_Q34_002_001
30.description: Your mannequin will be changed to a <hex:020813E4E80301FF054D616C65FF0746656D616C6503> <hex:02280AFF0552616365E8020103>. Proceed?

35.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_Q6_000_001
35.description: Your mannequin will be changed to a <hex:020823E1E80202FF0F66656D616C65204D69716F277465FF0D6D616C65204D69716F27746503>. Proceed?

39.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_Q8_000_001
39.description: Your mannequin's pose will be changed to <hex:022819FF14486F7573696E674D65726368616E74506F7365E8020203>. Proceed?

41.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
41.description: Nothin' fer ye to worry about.

43.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE4
43.description: Yes? <sigh> I hope this doesn't take long...

44.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
44.description: You wish to see how a master handles a bazaar?

47.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
47.description: What's it to be this time, love?

49.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
49.description: I'm so sorry to keep you waiting, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. So very, very sorry.

50.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
50.description: Quickly now, I've places to be.

51.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
51.description: Well, if it ain't my favorite client! Always a pleasure, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>!

53.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
53.description: What's on the agenda, chief? Deprivin' saps o' their hard-earned gil?

54.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE3
54.description: I have come. You may proceed.

55.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
55.description: Oh, hello there. To what do I owe the pleasure?

56.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
56.description: I am come to conduct business, and only business.

57.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
57.description: You look to be in good health, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. How may I assist you this fine <hex:02082EE3E90C0DFF14020810E3E90C05FF04657665FF056D6F726E03FF1302080FE3E90C12FF04646179FF046576650303>?

58.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
58.description: What is it you would have me do, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>?

59.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
59.description: Usually, it's me doin' the summons and others doin' the waitin'.

60.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE3
60.description: Is there something that I can help you with?

61.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
61.description: Oh, why must you summon me at a time like this...?

62.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
62.description: I'm sure there is a perfectly good explanation for this summons.

63.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
63.description: You know, I thought you might be along to summon me. You may rest assured that I am ready and eager to serve.

64.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
64.description: Hail to thee, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Your humble servant has heard your summons.

65.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
65.description: Greetin's and salutations, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>. Pray speak yer desires, an' I'll do me damndest to see 'em done.

66.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE3
66.description: I was wondering when you'd get around to calling me.

67.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
67.description: Mind if we keep this brief? I've got a pretty little thing that's waitin' for me.

70.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
70.description: Here I am, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>, as per your request.

72.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
72.description: I never miss a chance to line these pockets.

73.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
73.description: Well, this is unexpected! What'll it be?

76.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
76.description: How may I be of serrrvice, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>?

77.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
77.description: It's a war out there, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. You have no idea.

80.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
80.description: I presume you did not summon me solely for the pleasure of my company.

81.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
81.description: Just the <hex:020821E905FF0C66616972206D616964656EFF1068616E64736F6D652066656C6C6F7703> I was hoping to see! Tell me your heart's desire.

82.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
82.description: I hope your catcall is not one of disapproval.

84.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
84.description: A cat's ears do not miss much―least of all a summons.

85.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
85.description: Curiosity called the cat. What do you have for me today?

87.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
87.description: I was just thinking of you!

88.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
88.description: What need have you of me today, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>?

89.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
89.description: Bwahahaha! Ye got work needs gettin' done? Just point me in the right bloody direction.

91.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
91.description: Hey there─hic─<hex:020810E905FF066D69737379FF056D61746503>! Care to join me fer a pint?

92.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
92.description: Couldn't come no quicker. Where's the work?

93.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
93.description: I came runnin' soon as I heard the bell! Ye need somethin', chief?

95.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
95.description: Ye got somethin' fer me, cap'n?

97.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
97.description: Let's keep this short and sweet, shall we?

98.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
98.description: This wouldn't be necessary if you entrusted your financial affairs to me.

99.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
99.description: So─sellin', buyin', drinkin', whorin'? What's it to be today?

100.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
100.description: Greetings, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. How may I be of service?

105.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
105.description: We work the market stalls,♪<hex:02100103>And our uniforms are pretty;♪<hex:02100103>We are sober men and true,♪<hex:02100103>And attentive to our duties!♪

106.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
106.description: <hex:020815E905FF084D79206C616479FF084D79206C6F726403>. What would you ask of me?

109.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
109.description: Hey, it's...it's you! Hello again, you!

110.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
110.description: I-It's not like I want to sell your items or anything.

111.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
111.description: What do you have for me? Come on, come on! Don't be shy!

113.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
113.description: I trust this will be worth my while.

115.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
115.description: Whatever you need, leave it to me! I have my methods.

116.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
116.description: Gahaha! If it isn't my favorite <hex:020815E905FF096D69737472657373FF076D617374657203>!

117.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
117.description: It is I, your most loyal and capable retainer!

119.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE2
119.description: Your orders! I would hear them at once!

120.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
120.description: If there is something you would ask of me, then ask it.

122.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
122.description: A task for me? I hope it's something fun!

123.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
123.description: I am here to do your every bidding, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>! Ask of me anything at all!

124.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
124.description: I have been awaiting your summons, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. What would you have of me this fine <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF086D6F726E696E6703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303>?

128.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
128.description: Need my assistance, do you? Let's make this quick, then.

129.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
129.description: You have my ear, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>. Both of them, in fact!

131.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
131.description: At your beck an' call, I am!

132.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE3
132.description: You called, and I have come.

133.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
133.description: At last─I thought you'd <hex:021A020203>never<hex:021A020103> call. What does <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403> need of me?

134.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
134.description: Could it be...? The famous <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> has called on <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>? <chuckle>

135.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
135.description: Yes, yes, here I am! Ready at a moment's notice!

136.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
136.description: If that is all, I will take my leave now, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.

140.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
140.description: I believe thanks are in order.

143.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
143.description: Don't you worry 'bout a thing. I got this.

145.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
145.description: If there is nothing else, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, I'll be going now.

146.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
146.description: Is that all? Very well, until next time.

147.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
147.description: Oh, will that be all today? Very well, but promise me you'll come back soon!

148.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE1
148.description: As always, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, it has been an honor and a privilege.

149.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
149.description: You can count on me, chief─I know how to get things done.

151.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
151.description: I swear it shall be done. Eventually.

153.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
153.description: Capital! I shall carry out your orders forthwith.

154.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
154.description: I humbly await your next summons, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

155.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
155.description: Don't leave me alone for too long, hear?

157.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
157.description: That will be all, yes? Then if you would excuse me...

158.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
158.description: I believe that concludes our dealings for now.

159.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
159.description: Are you certain you don't desire anything else? Anything at all? Very well, I shall take my leave.

160.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
160.description: Your every whim shall be swiftly carried out with due care and consideration.

161.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
161.description: Shouldn't take more than a moment, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

163.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
163.description: Thank the gods we're finished. I've got plans to put my hands in places I've never seen...if you know what I mean.

167.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
167.description: Blessin's o' the Twelve upon ye.

168.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
168.description: May Nald'thal see fit to fatten our pockets!

169.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
169.description: Very good, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! Your wish is my command, and so forth.

170.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
170.description: You know how to reach me.

171.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE6
171.description: Is it time for good-byes already? I'm going to miss you...

173.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
173.description: The markets may be a bleedin' battlefield, but I'm a godsdamned soldier. You can count on me, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

175.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
175.description: Why so serrrious? <sigh> So it goes.

176.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
176.description: I hardly think that warranted my personal appearance, but what is done is done.

177.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
177.description: Then I have satisfied your every need? Excellent! I do so take pleasure in servicing my clients.

179.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
179.description: Right then, let's get on with it!

180.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
180.description: There is no call for concerrrn.

181.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
181.description: When the master's away, the cat will play.

183.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
183.description: You don't want to be with me anymore? <sniffle>

184.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
184.description: I shall carry out your wishes as instructed, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

185.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
185.description: Bwahahaha! I'm in yer bazaar, sellin' yer wares!

187.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
187.description: Awww, bugger. Reckon I best get to work...

189.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
189.description: Go and grab yourself some shut-eye, chief. You look terrible!

190.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
190.description: Will that be all for today, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>? Understood.

193.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
193.description: Not exactly how I was hopin' to spend my day, but I suppose it can't be helped.

194.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
194.description: Ours is not to reason why. Ours is but to do and die.

195.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
195.description: Ever the consummate professional, I see. Another time, then.

196.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
196.description: If there is nothing else, then I shall take my leave.

197.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
197.description: Is that all? Guess I'll be on my way, then.

198.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
198.description: Any last requests? Very well. Heh heh heh... Ahem.

199.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
199.description: Ah, yes, of course. Duty calls!

200.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
200.description: You are finished with me, then?

201.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
201.description: Here today and gone tomorrow;♪<hex:02100103>Yes, I know─♪<hex:02100103>That is so!♪

202.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
202.description: If ever you have need of me, just ring.

205.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
205.description: Finished already? Guess that's that, then.

206.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
206.description: You're leaving already? Fine, then! I-It's not like I wanted you to stay or anything.

209.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
209.description: Hmph. I hope that next time you will have a more meaningful task for me.

211.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
211.description: And with that, I shall be off. Places to go, people to see.

212.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
212.description: Bahahaha! Till next time, my friend!

213.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
213.description: Ring for me whenever you please! You know that I will never let you down!

216.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
216.description: Call on me as you please. If I am so inclined, I will answer.

217.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE4
217.description: That is all, I suppose...? <yawn> Very well...

218.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
218.description: That is all? Oh, I was hoping there'd be more...

219.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
219.description: Is that all you need of me? But I could yet serve you in so many ways!

220.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
220.description: Do not hesitate to call upon me again. Fare you well in your endeavors, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

221.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE2
221.description: Just say the word, yer <hex:020817E905FF096C61647973686970FF096C6F72647368697003>, and I'll be here with bells on.

222.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE3
222.description: If you have no further need of my services...

223.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE4
223.description: I'm off for another glass, then. You know where to find me!

224.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
224.description: What─is that it? Are you <hex:021A020203>sure<hex:021A020103> you need a retainer?

225.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
225.description: Nothing else? Then I shall be hopping along.

226.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE1
226.description: I'm glad to have been of service. Mind you don't overdo things, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

227.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
227.description: Had your fill of me, eh? Fair enough! Let me know if you need aught else!

228.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE3
228.description: We're done? Then I take my leave.

229.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
229.description: There's naught else <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403> requires? I'll be sharpening my claws, then, waiting for your next summons.

230.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
230.description: Nothing else? Right... I'll be off!

231.name: TEXT_HOUFURMERCHANT_00511_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
231.description: Have everything you need? I'll take a little nap, then.
